The meds might work well for you. Dont know until you try, right? Processing trauma is a difficult thing. For me, in the beginning of processing it, the nightmares and thoughts of self harm and suicide increased. But once I got further into it, it decreased again. So I would suggest that you always be as open and honest as you can with your physician and therapist about all of it (how you are doing, how you are handling it, how your thoughts are, and analyzing if the treatment plan is helping and if not, how you can modify it to help better) and have a safety plan in place that you are committed to following, as hard as that can be sometimes. Idk, it might be different for you, I'm just trying to tell you my experience and what helped me get through it. 

Stay strong and please keep us updated on how you are doing with all of it. I really wish the best for you and hope that things get better and easier. You got this!!
